why: The arrow outside any icon, a comment glued to its name inside its start tag, and a comment standing right before the mark's icon, each quoting an `<svg>`. Angular 22 reads the first as a comment the HTML tree holds beside the attributes and hands to a visitor only through `visitStartTagComment`. Every comment is blanked, each one, to its last character and no further, and with spaces: a quoted tag left in the text, a `<` blanked after a comment or a name glued to something other than a space would leave the text spelling an `<svg>` or a `<pct-icon>` more or fewer than the tree holds, and point 1 would fire on a template whose defect is point 2's.
